summary: Final acceptance at 93376db5 fails. The phase acceptance passed for S1 to S5, and every audited HEAD and baseline is bound by ancestry to current HEAD. The role gate then found one new failing test at HEAD that the S5 phase acceptance could not see: the S5 checkpoint commit 60253266 deleted the Resolved row 'IM3 auth wrapper inline duplication' from measure/tech-debt.md to stay under the 50-line limit, and apps/integrated-math-3/__tests__/lib/auth/server-composition.test.ts:230 requires that row. The final test sweep gives 219 failed (baseline 218) and 6844 passed, and gates.sh prints NEW FAILURE: test apps/integrated-math-3 has a new diagnostic. A targeted run reproduces 1 failed of 16 in that file. The two later commits also change measure/tracks.md and measure/tech-debt.md, which are not plan or evidence files of the track. Lint, checks-all, format check, doctor, and the static spec checks pass.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] final-acceptance: Commit 60253266 deletes the row '| IM3 auth wrapper inline duplication | Medium | Resolved |' from measure/tech-debt.md (git show 60253266 -- measure/tech-debt.md prints it at diff line 40), and apps/integrated-math-3/__tests__/lib/auth/server-composition.test.ts:230-235 requires that row to exist and to read Resolved. The final sweep gives 219 failed of 7068 against the baseline 218 of 7067, and gates.sh prints 'NEW FAILURE: test apps/integrated-math-3 has a new diagnostic' with NEWFAIL=1. Rationale: this is a real new failure at the audited HEAD, created after the S5 phase acceptance at f348394f, so the track does not meet AC8 ('The test, typecheck, and build gates have no new failure'). Fix: restore the row to measure/tech-debt.md (49 lines now, so the restore gives 50, inside the limit) or keep the record elsewhere that the test reads; a test edit would weaken the FR-14 guard.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Nit] final-acceptance: The later commits 60253266 and 93376db5 change measure/tech-debt.md and measure/tracks.md, and `git diff --name-only f348394f..HEAD` lists them with the plan, evidence, and test-strategy files. Under the strict coverage definition, tech-debt.md and tracks.md are not plan or evidence files. Rationale: the coverage rule is also not met, and the tech-debt change causes F1. The plan, evidence, and run-artifact paths of those commits are covered.

F3 [Nit] final-acceptance: The S5 carry list is record-only as the orchestrator ruled: Review A F4-F5, Review C F1-F3, ADV-S5-5, ADV-S5-6, PA1, PA2, PA4, PA5, and the `rg -nE` recipe note. Each has an Open row in measure/tech-debt.md (lines 38-49) and hides no gate failure. Rationale: the carry items need a later track; they are not pass claims.

F4 [Nit] final-acceptance: Stale checkboxes remain under completed tasks: plan.md lines 181-191 and 230-239 (S1 sub-boxes) and lines 620-623, 754, 757. The work is proven by the S1 phase acceptance evidence and by the checkpoints (c343e4b1, 60253266, 93376db5). Rationale: this is the recorded S1 F2 nit; the top-level tasks all hold [x] with a commit SHA.

F5 [Nit] final-acceptance: The checkpoint commit removed eight other Resolved tech-debt rows with the row of F1. No test or gate reads them (the sweep holds one new key), and tech-debt.md stays at 49 lines against the 50-line limit. Rationale: record pruning is the PM decision; only the F1 row breaks a test.
F6 [Nit] final-acceptance: measure/tracks.md:244 still says 'The S5 checkpoint is next' after 60253266 made the checkpoint. Rationale: the note is stale, not overstated (A6 holds).
